in.langText: Pick where you are. The time zone and keyboard follow; change them if they're not right.
in.tryKeyboard: Type here to try the keyboard
in.diskText: Pick the drive for NoCapOS. Everything on it will be replaced; your other drives stay as they are.
in.noDisks: No drive was found to install on. Connect one, then look again.
in.tooSmall: Too small: NoCapOS needs at least {min}.
in.lockHint: Your stuff can't be read if the drive is taken out of this computer.
in.tpm: Unlock automatically with this computer's security chip
in.tpmHint: No passphrase at start-up. You get a recovery key at the end, just in case.
in.passphraseHint: You'll type it each time the computer starts. If it's lost, so is your stuff.
in.advancedNote: Your other drives aren't touched. Later, in Storage, you can combine extra drives into a storage pool for your files.
in.accountText: This is you: the administrator of this NoCapOS.
in.usernameHint: Lowercase letters and numbers. You'll sign in with it.
in.userBad: Start with a letter; use only lowercase letters, numbers, - and _.
in.userTaken: That name is reserved. Pick another.
in.usageText: You can change this any time in Settings.
in.useBothText: NoCap Desktop on this screen, and NoCapOS in the browser on your phone, laptop and other devices at home.
in.useDesktopText: NoCap Desktop on this screen. Other devices can't open NoCapOS.
in.useWebText: No desktop on this computer. Use NoCapOS from your other devices' browsers.
in.usageLater: Settings > This Screen & Access switches between these later.
in.reviewText: Check everything. Nothing has changed yet.
in.understand: I understand that everything on {name} will be erased.
in.slideApps: One-click apps from the App Store, each in its own safe box.
in.slideFiles: Your files from any device, with sharing for family and friends.
in.slideShield: Shield keeps ads, trackers and strangers out.
in.slideLink: Link your phone: notifications, clipboard and files, both ways.
in.slideUpdates: Updates install in one piece and undo themselves if anything goes wrong.
in.failedText: Nothing is lost on your other drives. Restart from the USB stick and try again; these details help if it happens again.
in.doneText: Take out the USB stick, then restart. NoCapOS starts and signs you in with your new account.
in.recoveryText: Write it down and keep it somewhere safe. It unlocks your drive if the security chip ever can't.
